notes.title: Stretch tier — program total + $500k startup-cost recovery

notes.summary: Adds a **stretch tier** on top of the program revenue goal — extra revenue the team should capture to recover startup/seed capital in the same window. Defaults to **$500,000** for VTS; setting it to 0 hides the whole tier so other scorecards stay visually identical.

notes.title: Keep 6-month total goal, scale monthly cadence to 5 months
notes.raw_title: fix(scorecard): keep 6-month total goal, scale monthly cadence to 5 months
notes.summary: Follow-up to #130. When the program horizon shrank from 6 to 5 months, the total revenue target shrank with it — but that target is the number VTS was underwritten to deliver, not a pro-rata of program length. The right behavior is: **total stays**, **monthly cadence scales up** so the shorter window still lands the full 6-month goal.
notes.author: vectordev2001
